general_tolerance: UNLESS OTHERWISE SPECIFIED: THIRD ANGLE PROJECTION; DIMENSIONS IN INCHES; 2 PLACE DIM. ± .03; 3 PLACE DIM. ± [blank]; ANGULAR DIM. ± [blank].

views.description: Upper view: rectangular face with two concentric through-hole and counterbore outlines; third-angle projection.
views.centerline_notes: Cross centerlines locate two hole axes on a common row. Each counterbore is concentric with its clearance hole.

views.description: Lower view: rectangular elevation. Hidden stepped hole profiles show counterbores entering the top face and smaller holes continuing through the bottom.
views.centerline_notes: Vertical hole centerlines align with both centers in the top view.

dimensions.notes: Printed .500. No explicit tolerance; three-place general tolerance entry is blank. Default zero tolerance fields do not imply exactness.
Printed .500 ± .005; locates the common hole row.

Full leader callout: DR. & C'BORE FOR .312-18 SOC. HD. SCR. 2 HLS. This specifies mating socket-head screws, NOT tapped holes and NOT the clearance drill diameter. 18 denotes threads per inch. No thread class or series is explicitly given.
Derived nominal dimension: D001 - D002 - D003 = 3.00 - .500 - 2.000 = .500. Not printed; no independent tolerance.
Derived nominal coordinate: D002 + D003 = .500 + 2.000 = 2.500. Not printed; no independent tolerance.
Derived nominal coordinate: D005 - D004 = 1.000 - .500 = .500. Controlling offset is from the upper edge. Not printed; no independent tolerance.

features.description: Rectangular key-stock base: 3.00 long by 1.000 wide, extruded 1.00 thick. In-plane coordinate origin is the lower-left corner of the top view.

Two through clearance holes for .312-18 socket-head screws, normal to the top face. Nominal edge-referenced instance positions, in inches: [[0.500,0.500],[2.500,0.500]]. Linear spacing 2.000 ± .005. Hole diameter is unspecified and requires confirmation; .312 is the screw designation, not an authorized clearance diameter.

Two flat-bottom counterbores entering the top face, coaxial with the two through holes at nominal edge-referenced positions [[0.500,0.500],[2.500,0.500]] inches. Counterbore diameter and depth are unspecified and require confirmation.

symmetry.description: Nominal end offsets are both .500. Right offset is derived, not independently controlled.
Nominal hole row is centered across the width. Separate width and upper-edge-offset tolerances mean exact symmetry is not required.

concentric_groups.description: Each counterbore is coaxial with its corresponding through hole. The two separate hole locations are not coaxial with each other.

dimension_chains.description: Nominal transverse closure: 1.000 = .500 upper-edge offset + .500 derived lower-edge offset.

warnings: The actual clearance-hole diameter, counterbore diameter, and counterbore depth are not specified. Human confirmation or an authorized shop standard is required before building the holes.

The reporting tool requires a positive hole diameter and rejects an unknown diameter encoded as zero. Consequently hole_callouts is empty rather than inventing a diameter. The complete two-hole callout is preserved in D007, and its through/counterbore interpretation, quantity, positions, and spacing are preserved in F002/F003 and relationships.
The three-place and angular general tolerance entries are blank. The printed .500 left-edge offset therefore has no recoverable tolerance.
No ASME, ISO, or DIN standard is explicitly named. Inch units and third-angle projection are explicit.
KEY STOCK identifies stock form but no alloy, grade, or hardness. Heat-treatment and finish requirements are not supplied.
135-A is the complete drawing/part number; the A suffix is not assumed to be a separate revision. The change table is blank.
Title block also lists MODEL No. 250BX.
No GD&T feature-control frames, datum identifiers, fillet dimensions, or chamfer dimensions are shown.
Hole positions are nominal coordinates derived from the printed offsets and spacing. Preserve the upper-edge transverse offset as controlling rather than imposing exact mid-width symmetry.
Build order is conditional on resolving missing hole and counterbore sizes; do not infer sizes from pictorial scale.
